text:
alex: Morning team — quick lift-off check. What I did: landed the prefetch -> slot-align refactor (PR 452), ran a microbench across 4 shards. Observed ~2% p95 gain but saw 1 reproducible microburst OOM on slot 12 after ~1.2M tokens.
maya: Nice, thanks. Can you paste the failing worker logs?
alex: pasted below from the canary: ```[2026-03-18T08:12:23Z] OOM on device 0, slot=12, mem_used=93.5%
stack: runtime::alloc -> kv::load_prefetch -> kernel::prefetch_hook```
sam: hmm looks like the prefetch touched a large keyset. Did you bump the per-slot cache limit?
alex: not yet — still using default 256MB/slot. The hot key distribution for that shard spikes occasionally.
joanne: @alex ping PR 452 — left a small comment about the `prefetch_window` math. Could be off-by-one causing overlapping async copies.
alex: saw it, fixing now.
sam: For mitigation, can we set `--slot-cache-max=192MB` via the canary config and rerun microbench? Might avoid the OOM while we debug.
maya: I can deploy that quick. Which canary pool? `canary-west-2a`?
alex: yes, canary-west-2a is the one that hit it. Maya, thanks. After deploy, run the same bench: `./scripts/microbench --shards=4 --seq=1024 --iters=250k` and post results.
perf-bot: microbench finished (run 2026-03-18T08:26:12Z) — p95: 18.3ms (-1.9%), p99: 39.2ms (-0.7%), OOMs: 0.
maya: rolled slot-cache to 192MB on canary-west-2a and re-ran. Results look clean so far. No OOMs in 30m smokecheck.
sam: sounds like a good short-term mitig. Long-term we should adapt slot size by observed hot-key tail. Maybe `slot_scale` heuristic?
joanne: agreed. I can prototype an adaptive cap in the example config and run a 24h soak if we want.
alex: thanks — short list for today: 1) push fix for off-by-one in prefetch (PR update), 2) formalize adaptive slot cap RFC draft, 3) run 24h soak on canary if joanne has prototype. Blocker: need approval on the quick rollback knob in PR 452 so ops can toggle prefetch via runtime flag.
maya: I'll approve the rollback knob change once tests pass. Also adding an alert on `kernel.slot_oom` to SRE so we see it earlier.
sam: FYI I queued a follow-up perf sweep for higher batch sizes (batch=8,16) to validate no regression on latent qps. Will post numbers in this thread.
alex: thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the off-by-one repro, I’ll be at my desk (zoom in 10). :slightly_smiling_face:
perf-bot: scheduled perf sweep (batch sizes 8/16) — results will land in ~45m: https://console.redwood/prod/dashboards/perf/1785554321
maya: cool — I'll watch the dashboard and tag SRE if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
